editorial_thesis: Trustworthy agent adoption now depends on process evidence, model-independent runtime boundaries, and a human-owned defensive response loop.

topic_groups.title: Agent Evaluation + Human Collaboration
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A neglected lane with immediate leverage: turn agent quality from “did it finish?” into observable process, collaboration, and constraint compliance.

sources.title: Kolab: benchmark the handoff, not just the task
sources.why_selected: Autonomous completion scores miss the moment where work leaves the chat and enters a real workflow.
sources.usefulness: model whether a person will adopt, edit, or reject an output

sources.title: cxbench: outcome pass can still be unsafe
sources.why_selected: 55.48% of runs were false-passes: the record looked right while the sequence, disclosure, or authority was wrong.
sources.usefulness: regulated customer workflows and approval gates

sources.title: SkillForgeBench: strict completion exposes the gap
sources.why_selected: Plausible deliverables hide failures in procedure, verification, formatting, and scope discipline.
sources.usefulness: evaluate skills, runbooks, and long-horizon agent jobs

sources.title: AgentKit’s lifecycle is becoming the product
sources.why_selected: The competitive unit is shifting from a model call to a governed build-to-evaluation loop.
sources.usefulness: compare visual orchestration with code-first delivery

sources.title: Buildn pattern: a three-score run packet
sources.why_selected: This creates a shared language for engineering, operations, and clients without pretending one scalar score is enough.
sources.usefulness: client readiness and internal scheduled jobs

topic_groups.title: Agent Runtime Controls + Local Boundaries
topic_groups.selection_rationale: This lane extends yesterday’s boundary theme with fresh implementation signals and a concrete telemetry failure; it is a material update, not a repeat.

sources.title: GitHub local sandboxing is generally available
sources.why_selected: The policy applies independently of the model, a useful separation for any multi-provider runtime.

sources.title: Local models enter the same workflow surface
sources.why_selected: Model portability becomes useful when routing is attached to the same permissions, artifacts, and review loop.
sources.usefulness: evaluate local/cloud routing without UI forks

sources.title: Parallel sessions need lifecycle hygiene
sources.why_selected: Concurrency without cleanup turns agent autonomy into resource drift and hidden state.

sources.title: Telemetry gaps can corrupt adoption decisions
sources.why_selected: A polished dashboard can still be measuring the wrong population; missing history cannot be recovered.
sources.usefulness: audit metrics before using them for ROI

sources.title: Buildn pattern: policy, evidence, cleanup
sources.why_selected: Boundary controls are only operational when operators can see and reset them.

topic_groups.title: Defensive Agent Operations
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Security is a fresh adjacent lane today, grounded in a new primary-source case and useful for client patching and agent safety offers.

sources.title: Patch the Planet: agents in coordinated disclosure
sources.why_selected: The valuable unit is not autonomous discovery alone; it is the response chain that creates preparation time before public exploitation.
sources.usefulness: build defensive patch triage with provenance

sources.title: The defensive loop needs evidence
sources.why_selected: Agent-generated findings become useful only when they reduce time-to-safe-state without creating an unverifiable change.

sources.title: Frontier discovery increases dual-use pressure
sources.why_selected: Security deployments need controls around data access, exploit material, egress, and disclosure timing—not only model accuracy.

sources.title: Buildn offer: vulnerability response rehearsal
sources.why_selected: It converts an abstract AI-security story into a controlled operational capability.

sources.title: Governance is part of the technical path
sources.why_selected: The control surface is socio-technical: the agent can accelerate analysis, but legitimacy and timing remain governed by accountable humans.
sources.usefulness: Buildn OS controls and client playbooks
